LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A single global Top 10 arcade race score in Marble Rush.

name.description: Uppercase player display name (1 to 10 characters, A-Z, 0-9, or space).

time.description: Final race time in seconds (between 5 and 3600).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public global Marble Rush Top 10 leaderboard scores (append-only, no PII).
